effects.description: (4 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) Dealing direct damage generates a stack of Gorethief for |cffffff30|r seconds, up to |cffffff10|r stacks. While you have Gorethief equipped, Roll Dodge consumes 1 stack and heals you for |cffffff2021|r Health, scaling off your Max Health.

At max stacks, while you have Gorethief equipped, bash an enemy to consume all stacks and deal |cffffff2144|r Bleed Damage, scaling off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage, to enemies within |cffffff8|r meters of you.
